  input application_for_adjustment_pending content boolean

declaration scope SubstantialPresenceTest:
  input days_current_year content integer
  input days_first_preceding_year content integer
  input days_second_preceding_year content integer
  input excluded_days_current_year content integer
  input excluded_days_first_preceding_year content integer
  input excluded_days_second_preceding_year content integer
  input has_tax_home_in_foreign_country content boolean
  input has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country_than_united_states content boolean
  input application_for_adjustment_pending content boolean
  input took_steps_for_lpr_status content boolean
  subparagraph_b_check scope SubparagraphBNotApplyCertainCases
  internal adjusted_days_current_year content integer
  internal adjusted_days_first_preceding_year content integer
  internal adjusted_days_second_preceding_year content integer
  internal weighted_days content decimal
  output meets_test content boolean

scope ExceptionExemptIndividualsCertainMedicalConditions:

scope SubparagraphBNotApplyCertainCases:

scope SubstantialPresenceTest:

definition day_excluded_from_presence equals
    is_exempt_individual or
    (unable_to_leave_united_states and
     medical_condition_arose_while_present_in_united_states)

definition subparagraph_b_not_applies equals
    application_for_adjustment_pending or
    took_steps_for_lpr_status

definition subparagraph_b_check.application_for_adjustment_pending equals
    application_for_adjustment_pending

definition subparagraph_b_check.took_steps_for_lpr_status equals
    took_steps_for_lpr_status

definition adjusted_days_current_year equals
    days_current_year - excluded_days_current_year

definition adjusted_days_first_preceding_year equals
    days_first_preceding_year - excluded_days_first_preceding_year

definition adjusted_days_second_preceding_year equals
    days_second_preceding_year - excluded_days_second_preceding_year

definition weighted_days equals
    (decimal_of_integer adjusted_days_current_year) +
    (decimal_of_integer adjusted_days_first_preceding_year) / 3.0 +
    (decimal_of_integer adjusted_days_second_preceding_year) / 6.0

definition meets_test equals
    adjusted_days_current_year >= 31 and
    weighted_days >= 183.0

exception [label exception_closer_connection] definition meets_test
    under condition
      adjusted_days_current_year < 183 and
      has_tax_home_in_foreign_country and
      has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country_than_united_states
    consequence equals false

exception exception_closer_connection definition meets_test
    under condition
      subparagraph_b_check.subparagraph_b_not_applies
    consequence equals
      adjusted_days_current_year >= 31 and
      weighted_days >= 183.0

signals.condition: as otherwise provided in paragraph (b)(3) — sibling provisions in the same paragraph can override the general conclusion
present fewer than 183 days in current year and has tax home in foreign country and has closer connection to that foreign country than to United States

application for adjustment of status pending or individual took other steps to apply for lawful permanent resident status at any time during the current year — negates subparagraph (B) closer-connection exception, restoring base SPT rule
day_excluded_from_presence is true for that day
signals.reduces_by: number of days in the year for which day_excluded_from_presence holds

signals.condition: day_excluded_from_presence is true for that day
signals.reduces_by: number of days in first preceding year for which day_excluded_from_presence holds

signals.condition: day_excluded_from_presence is true for that day
signals.reduces_by: number of days in second preceding year for which day_excluded_from_presence holds

signals.condition: adjusted_days_current_year < 183 and has_tax_home_in_foreign_country and has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country_than_united_states — subparagraph (B) closer-connection exception forces meets_test to false
subparagraph_b_check.subparagraph_b_not_applies — subparagraph (C) negates the closer-connection exception via exception-to-exception, restoring base SPT formula
